name: Kurate (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kurate town emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter Y.
history: Municipal flag of Kurate, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1956.

features.role: Kurate town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter Y
